# jamfplatform_pro_service_discovery_enrollment (Data Source)

Read the current Jamf Pro service-discovery ("well-known") settings for Account-Driven enrollment. Returns one row per synced Apple Business/School Manager (AxM) organization, with its `server_uuid`, display name, and current `enrollment_type`. Useful for discovering the `server_uuid` values to manage with `jamfplatform_pro_service_discovery_enrollment`. Requires Jamf Pro 11.25.0 or later. Singleton — one record per tenant.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Jamf Pro privilege | Scoped name |
|---|---|
| Read User-Initiated Enrollment | `read:pro:user-initiated-enrollment` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the current Jamf Pro service-discovery ("well-known") settings. Returns one row
# per synced Apple Business / School Manager organization — useful for discovering the
# Server UUIDs to manage with jamfplatform_pro_service_discovery_enrollment.
data "jamfplatform_pro_service_discovery_enrollment" "current" {}

output "service_discovery_rows" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_service_discovery_enrollment.current.well_known_setting
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.
- `well_known_setting` (Attributes List) One row per synced AxM organization Jamf Pro knows about. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--well_known_setting))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--well_known_setting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `well_known_setting`

Read-Only:

- `enrollment_type` (String) Current Account-Driven enrollment type hosted for this org: `none`, `mdm-byod`, or `mdm-adde`.
- `org_name` (String) Display name of the Apple Business/School Manager organization.
- `server_uuid` (String) Server UUID of the organization's Automated Device Enrollment token.
